priority: Subtask under existing RETINA R41S1H workstream; R42B independent antenna/custodian evidence remains critical path
interpretation: Hawking co-launched Breakthrough Listen; BLC1 analysis motivates physically distinct clock sidebands and intermodulation diagnostics. No claim that Hawking invented RFI filters.
science: Predefine oscillator sideband and 2f1-f2 intermod closure evidence, and off-trajectory frequency-coherent peaks. A narrow isolated extraterrestrial-looking line cannot be automatically distinguished from a solitary terrestrial oscillator based on one view. Require independent ON/OFF/pointing before any causal source assignment.

feature_spec.source: 16x256 synthetic narrowband native-like spectrograms and a label-blind candidate path. Real native R42B features must use actual Hz, reference frame, absolute oscillator spacing and matched scan time. No source labels fed to feature function.
feature_spec.transforms: Per-epoch median and MAD-normalized power, candidate-relative offsets Δ={8,12,16,24} bins; ±Δ, ±2Δ. Score clock symmetric and harmonically spaced sidebands with common drift, intermod closure f0=2f1-f2 when f1=f0±Δ and f2=f0±2Δ, coherent modulation and off-path broadband occupancy. Offset in bins is only engineering approximation; do not infer real clock Hz without native frequency calibration.
feature_spec.fundamental_harmonic_rule: Never claim 2*f0 is present if outside observed native band; store coverage=false and do not assign harmonic classification.

synthetic_simulators.generator: Colored noise and independent time-varying baseline per spectrum; positive families single-line tracks at different amplitudes/active rows; null families clock sidebands, 2f1-f2 closure, impulsive broadband and single electronic carrier, where latter is deliberately visually indistinguishable from an isolated source.
synthetic_simulators.source_claim_limit: Synthetic 'positive' and 'null' mean declared generator labels only, not astrophysical origin of single-view morphology.

method.blind_candidate_search: One frozen straight-line candidate search for both classes, start bins 48..207 step2 and slopes -1.25,-.75,-.25,0,.25,.75,1.25; no truth path
method.model: StandardScaler+LogisticRegression C=0.1 class_weight=balanced random_state=411103, intercept; only six physical RFI features, no JANUS/NOISE scores
method.train: All dev seeds only; holdout seeds entirely unseen before model/threshold fixed
method.locked_veto_threshold: Higher RFI score means stronger evidence for family RFI. nextafter(max(development positive scores), +infinity) to preserve every dev positive; audit hypothetical only, zero actual veto
method.comparison: Fixed baseline family evidence via comb strength only; AUC and family breakdown on heldout; no selection among variants after seeing test
method.shift_stability: No-wrap +/-8/16 frequency bins, fill new edge bins from each row median, transform path by identical shift. Compare normalized features and frozen-model margins without retuning.
method.negative_control: Single-electronic-carrier RFI cannot be physically distinguished from single narrow source without independent supporting evidence; report conditional performance and never suppress based on this type.

gates.engineering_pass: Original/provisional fixed protocol validated, source code unit tests pass, each evaluation run returns all per-seed counts and invariant raw identity.
gates.exploratory_discrimination: AUC >=0.70 on both heldout seeds, with no cheating on labels, report simpler comb baseline; not a production gate
gates.conservative_preservation: Zero positive injection losses under locked advisory threshold on both heldout seeds, no more than 1% polarity flips under shifts; any failure rejects proposed hard-veto pathway
gates.baseline_alert_preservation: All original 318 and 69 remain because shadow-only; no empirical claim of reduced 51 historical false alerts.
gates.external_real_validation: HOLD R42B, authentic TCS/ScanLog and external custodian for new ON/OFF groups; no use of historical 38 control truth to train or calibrate

deferred.hawking_transient: HOLD until after R42B; separate astrophysical transients need independent time resolution/polarimetry and physical sensitivity limits
deferred.monitor: NRAO GBT ticket 58509 is separate and pending
